_meta: CharacterAppear bg-only prerender manifest (Pass-10). Per-viewRarity prerendered BACKGROUND VFX layers only — cosmic galaxy, central radial burst, URP bloom, gradation/frame URP shaders, ef_sageBg particles. Composited BEHIND PrefabTree/DOM in FullArtRevealStage. The DOM foreground renders: character d2 art + plate body/frame + character name/title text + per-star sprites + per-star scale-pop animation + per-star burst particle VFX via LotteryParticles. Plate+stars are NOT in the video (Pass-10 layer split — plate must render IN FRONT of character, which is impossible if it's baked into the bg). When a clip is null, the website falls back to the full CSS LotteryParticles pipeline for that rarity.

_clip_shape.alpha_mode: alpha-webm | premultiplied-on-black-mp4 | straight-on-black-mp4 — how the clip encodes transparency. alpha-webm = VP9-alpha (yuva420p); -on-black-* = no alpha channel, composite via mix-blend-mode in CSS
_clip_shape.composite_mode: normal | screen | plus-lighter — CSS mix-blend-mode used to composite the video onto the stage backdrop. 'normal' for alpha-webm; 'plus-lighter' (additive) or 'screen' for on-black variants. Note: CSS uses 'plus-lighter' for additive, NOT 'lighter' (which is a canvas-only globalCompositeOperation value).
_clip_shape.design_resolution: [1920, 1080] — native 16:9. Captured at 1920x1080 logical phone screen via `adb shell wm size 1080x1920` override (forces the phone to report a 16:9 screen to the game's CanvasScaler, so the prefab's 1920x1080 container fills the entire phone screen with no gutters). screenrecord --size 1920x1080 captures the logical area directly.
_clip_shape.start_offset_s: offset from CharacterAppear In() start to first visible frame in the clip (usually 0)
_clip_shape.included_paths: array of GameObject paths visible in the prerender (informational; the source of truth is character_appear_vfx_prerender_layer_split.md §INCLUDED)
_clip_shape.hidden_paths: array of GameObject paths hidden at capture time (informational; see character_appear_vfx_prerender_layer_split.md §HIDDEN)
_clip_shape.notes: free-text notes (capture device, codec, any deviations from protocol)

_common_capture_metadata.capture_method: phone-arm64-frida-hidehook + adb wm size 1080x1920 override (force game canvas to 16:9, container fills screen, no gutters/SKIP-overflow) + adb screenrecord --size 1920x1080 ~21Mbps + ffmpeg trim only (source is already 16:9) + vp9 4Mbps yuv420p
_common_capture_metadata.encode_filter_chain: (none — source is already 16:9 native; just -ss/-t trim)
_common_capture_metadata.encode_rationale: Pass-11: forced phone to report 1080x1920 via `adb shell wm size 1080x1920`. The game's CanvasScaler computes a 16:9 logical canvas matching the prefab's 1920x1080 container — no DefaultCanvas-extension gutters, all UI (including the SKIP button at the top-right) fits within the captured 16:9 frame. No letterbox needed in the encode.
_common_capture_metadata.force_rarity_method: Set/Initialize hook + raw-memory write at Entity+0x40 (RarityType enum int)
_common_capture_metadata.hide_method: Interceptor.attach on UILotteryCharacterAppear.In() + Transform.Find(relPath) + SetActive(false) on 7 paths (Pass-10 bg mode)
included_paths_summary: container/bgPattern, bgPatternAdd, noise, shadow, gradation*, frameURUltimate
URP Bloom + ColorAdjustments + Vignette (baked into frames)
hidden_paths_summary: container/characterName/rarityStar (DOM — star sprites + per-star scale curve + per-star burst LotteryParticles)
container/btnSkip/ic, container/btnSkip/label (DOM — replaced by website SKIP button)
known_residual_artifacts: Tiny rarity1/rarity2 star sprites briefly appear in some captures because the Appear<rarity> AnimationClip's m_IsActive curves re-activate them ~50-100ms after our SetActive(false). The website's DOM star sprites overlay these exactly (same prefab RectTransform anchors), so they're hidden behind the DOM stars in compositing.
Skip arrow icon (>>) at top-right corner remains visible in all captures (we only hide btnSkip/label, not btnSkip/ic). DOM SKIP button will overlay it cleanly.
